claims.text: The study reports an accuracy of 65.3% and an F1 score of 77.6% for classifying security-relevant commits based on commit diffs.
The models are benchmarked against a logistic regression baseline that uses one-hot representations of Java tokens extracted from commit diffs.
The study employs dropout for regularization and uses Adam optimizer with a learning rate of 0.001.
